description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to monitoring and evaluating the health of communication channels, including logic for assessing channel status and determining restart reasons.

methods.name: isManagedAccount
methods.description: Checks if a channel snapshot is managed based on its enabled and configured flags.

methods.name: evaluateChannelHealth
methods.description: Evaluates the health of a channel based on its snapshot and policy, returning an evaluation object.

methods.name: resolveChannelRestartReason
methods.description: Determines the reason for restarting a channel based on its snapshot and health evaluation.
